EDR-bot: [ALERT] Suspicious svc_loader activity detected on host RDW-LT-042 (user: alex). Severity: high. Action: auto-quarantine network interface.
priya (secops): seeing it, thx. Is the device already isolated from network?
tom (it-support): yes — EDR applied network quarantine at 10:12 UTC. remote session open to confirm.
EDR-bot: quarantine applied by policy 'isolate-on-svc-loader' at 10:12:04 UTC. Files flagged: C:\Windows\Temp\svc_loader.dll (sha256: d4f7e3...).
alex (eng-qa): omg — I was just running a local test harness earlier, might be related but i didn't touch downloads. will stand by.
priya (secops): alex — please do not connect the laptop to any external network or VPN until we say so. tom, can you grab serial + OS build?
tom (it-support): serial: SN-RDW042. OS: Win10 22H2. AV shows quarantine for the dll, but EDR flagged suspicious persistence attempt (svc registration).
alex (eng-qa): noted — i'll leave it powered on and plugged in.
priya (secops): uploading case to our tracker and assigning IR-1795. Tom, please do a full image if possible. If not, capture Volatility memory dump + list of running services. Use this runbook: 
```
# triage steps
1) isolate (done)
2) dump-memory --host RDW-LT-042 --out /cases/IR-1795/memdump.raw
3) collect-services --format json > /cases/IR-1795/services.json
4) export EDR logs (last 24h)
```

maria (people-ops): do we need to pause alex's access to internal apps while this is triaged?
priya (secops): yes, reduce alex's session tokens and rotate any active service creds. Marking RBAC change request for SRE team.
tom (it-support): starting memory dump now. ETA ~12 min. copying EDR logs to case.
alex (eng-qa): i consent to image/dump — let me know if you need physical handover.
priya (secops): thanks. also request: upload sample to analysis sandbox and VirusTotal, but restrict sharing (sensitive). Tag sample as private and add to pf_ring YARA watchlist if confirmed.
EDR-bot: sample uploaded to sandbox job 5798, detonation queued.
priya (secops): follow-up owner: priya. post-incident actions: (1) finalize triage, (2) decide re-image vs clean restore, (3) add prevention rule to EDR policy, (4) update runbook gaps.
maria (people-ops): i'll draft a short comms note for alex's team and HR about next steps. keep me in loop for any PII risk.
priya (secops): quick ask for infra/sre: if this touches service credentials, we'll want to rotate KMS access keys used by any local dev tooling. tagging @sre (not present in thread) — will open a follow-up ticket.
tom (it-support): memory dump complete. transferring to /cases/IR-1795/memdump.raw (scp in progress).
priya (secops): good. We'll reconvene in #eng-security in 30m with initial findings. Thanks everyone. :pray:
